description: This file defines the 'LocalizedConverter' interface in Java, which extends the 'Converter' interface to support localization features such as locale and time zone-specific conversions. It declares multiple overloaded 'convert' methods to convert objects between types with localization context.

classes.name: LocalizedConverter
classes.description: A Java interface for converting objects with locale and timezone considerations. Implements conversion methods between source and target types, with support for optional formatting.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a source object to target type T, considering locale and timezone, with overloads supporting target class and format string.
